name: Holix
description: Server plugin for the Holix Play client. Every Holix profile is a hidden Jellyfin user, so watch state, Next Up and parental controls work natively on the server. Age ratings (all, 7+, 13+, 16+, 18+) become Jellyfin parental limits (TR/US/DE rating systems), profile sessions can require a PIN verified by holix-cloud (Ed25519-signed, single-use proof), and guest profiles keep no watch history.
overview: Holix Play profiles: household profiles, parental controls, guest mode

versions.changelog: - Removed the ClipsUrl setting; preview clips now use Jellyfin's standard theme videos (backdrops folder).

- New `ClipsUrl` setting (Dashboard → Plugins → Holix): the address of the holix-clips service that makes short background preview clips for this server. It is announced to clients as `ClipsUrl` in `/Holix/Info`, so it no longer has to be typed into every client. Left out of the response when empty or not an absolute http(s) URL; a trailing `/` is removed. The plugin never contacts this URL. New feature flag `clips-url`.

- New `GET /Holix/StreamAuth`: a Traefik `forwardAuth` / nginx `auth_request` endpoint that closes Jellyfin's unauthenticated stream URLs at the reverse proxy. Stream paths (`/Videos/{id}/…`, `/Audio/{id}/…`) are allowed only for a valid token whose user may see the item (library access, parental rating, blocked tags — Jellyfin's own item check): 204 / 401 / 403 / 404. Decisions are cached for 60 s (max. 10 000 entries). Callable only from `StreamAuthAllowedProxies` (new setting; default loopback and private networks). Traefik and nginx examples in the README. - Turkish rating labels that Jellyfin does not know — "Genel İzleyici" (and "Genel", "GENEL", …), "7 yaş ve üzeri", "13 yaş ve üzeri", "18 yaş ve üzeri" and RTÜK content signs such as "Olumsuz Öğeler İçerir" — are now scored by the plugin instead of being treated as unrated, so child profiles no longer hide general-audience Turkish content. Item metadata is not changed; existing items are rescored once at start-up. - holix-cloud proof clock-skew allowance lowered from 30 s to 10 s (`exp` and future `iat`/`nbf`); a proof captured before a server restart can now be replayed for at most 70 s instead of 90 s.

- Age thresholds now use the band's age, identical across rating systems (TR/US/DE); the rating system only selects the label. A 7+ profile now sees US TV-Y7 in every system. - `POST /Holix/Household/Link` returns the updated household (same body as `GET /Holix/Household`). - New `PUT` / `DELETE /Holix/Profiles/{id}/Image`: profile pictures are stored as the Jellyfin user image. - The profile image directory is validated to stay inside Jellyfin's user configuration directory. - holix-cloud URL defaults to `https://api.holixplay.com`.
